title: LangSmith observability and evaluation
limitations: Supplementary original material: no source-video timestamp or source-video figures.
Authoring validation is offline only; the parent must execute real Anthropic demo and solution calls and verify traces.
Local assigned run IDs and callback ancestry do not prove remote persistence; flush, read-back, and dashboard inspection are separate evidence.
The three-example JSON-text reports are local evaluations, not uploaded LangSmith datasets or experiments.
Graph formatting is bounded to two model invocations per case; SDK transport retries can issue additional requests.
Model or tool exceptions propagate and can prevent report creation; failed completed evaluations save reports before asserting.
The lab uses deterministic tool selection and no retrieval; RAG evidence discussion refers to L11 rather than claiming an S1 retrieval run.
The shared helper uses project addressing; agent-based workspaces require instructor provisioning and a compatibility project name.
A tracing-only key cannot perform stored read-back; the service checker needs appropriate ingestion and read permissions.
The learner-starter acceptance check is intentionally skipped until all three TODO functions are implemented.
Windows execution and dashboard visibility were not validated by this module author.
